text: Anxiety and fear: with this pattern, it helps to first figure out what is providing the stimulation for the anxiety. CBT-style reality testing, checking the frightening thought against what's actually happening, is one way to do that which could be explored with a therapist if it persists, but can be done without one to start with. In general, it can help to have grounding/relaxing routines (like morning or bedtime yin yoga, meeting a friend for lunch).
